facts.fact: La Nouvelle Tribune reports a communique of the Centre national d'investigation numerique (CNIN) saying the law protects victims of AI-generated fake videos and that creators and sharers face prosecution, with courts applying the same penalties to both.

BEN.note: Document states no government use of AI.
Document states no AI tool in a sector's public system.
Document states no AI built or hosted in the country.
Document gives no internet usage figure.
